title: Fix Healer to Check Canonical on Every Click
revision_note: Codex review #1: source corrected to full-quality .png; damage detection expanded; scripted post-heal sanity check added. Codex review #2: normalize/inset before bake; regenerate Assets.car (or remove if actool unavailable); stamp DockPopsIconRecipeVersion in Info.plist before signing; Path B verification failure is now STOP-and-redesign, not silent fallback to Path A.
contract: On every click of a poplet, the poplet checks whether the bundle needs healing (canonical .png newer than ICNS, recipe version mismatch, missing ICNS, missing Icon\r, or missing FinderInfo xattr) and rewrites the bundle in place from the 1024² canonical .png if so.

canonical_source.reason: .live.png is a 256² derived runtime variant. iconutil needs 1024² to fill all ICNS slots without upscaling.

in_scope: Change healer source from Companion mirror to canonical .png (1024² master)
Normalize/inset via PopletIconRendering.normalizedCanvas before baking ICNS (match Companion's pipeline)
Regenerate or remove Assets.car during heal (regenerate if actool available, else delete + clear CFBundleIconName)
Stamp DockPopsIconRecipeVersion = 13 in bundle Info.plist before signing
Implement Path B in healer: strip + regenerate ICNS + Assets.car + recipe-stamp + sign + reapply Finder custom icon
Revise SACRED ZONE #28 to reflect new strategy
out_of_scope: Cross-repo changes in DockPops Main (Codex's alternative structural fix deferred)
Stored source fingerprint/hash in Info.plist (deferred strengthening)

decisions.source_path: canonical .png (1024² master) in Group Containers, NOT .live.png
decisions.finder_icon_strategy: Path B: strip + regenerate + sign + reapply, with manual flash verification + scripted post-heal check
decisions.repair_existing: yes, on first click (driven by broader bundleNeedsHeal)
decisions.fallback_if_flash: STOP and redesign. Path A is not an acceptable fallback because it re-introduces the Tahoe plate that US-2 rules out.
decisions.normalize_before_bake: regenerateICNS pipes through PopletIconRendering.normalizedCanvas(from:) before baking iconset variants — matches Companion's normalizedPopletAppIcon path at PopletSyncService.swift:341
decisions.assets_car_strategy: If actool available: regenerate via same path Companion uses. If actool unavailable (typical end-user machine): delete Contents/Resources/Assets.car AND remove CFBundleIconName key from Info.plist.
decisions.recipe_version_writeback: Write DockPopsIconRecipeVersion = Self.iconRecipeVersion into bundle Info.plist BEFORE signing. Without this, future version bumps cause perpetual re-healing.

risks: Path B leaves bundle signature invalid under --strict; healer runs repeatedly (vs once at generation time) so LSD behavior may differ
Non-atomic write of canonical .png could be read mid-write; mitigated by skipping heal on read failure
Adding heal to every reopen multiplies codesign invocations; bundleNeedsHeal short-circuits the steady-state to ~stat calls
7ca31d0 flash diagnosis may need re-validation; Phase 2 verification covers this
Codex P1/P2: This fix is repair-on-next-click, not self-update-while-closed. Cross-repo Main-owns-bundles alternative deferred.
Codex P2: bundleNeedsHeal triggers on file presence, not content hash. Stored fingerprint in Info.plist deferred as strengthening pass.
Codex review #2: actool is bundled with Xcode and typically absent on end-user machines. Assets.car path therefore needs both branches; delete-path is the normal user case.
Codex review #2: Writing Info.plist before signing means signature covers the updated version stamp. Writing after would invalidate the strict signature for an extra reason (beyond just FinderInfo).
